tools.name: POST_askAgent
tools.title: POST_askAgent
tools.description: This is the conversation endpoint for the AI agent. A session must be created before sending any messages. See createSession.

parameters.name: ucssa-userid
parameters.description: The user ID of the requesting user

parameters.name: ucssa-username
parameters.description: The username of the requesting user

parameters.name: ucssa-bps
parameters.description: JSON array of business partner IDs, e.g. ["1113855"]

tools.name: POST_createSession
tools.title: POST_createSession
tools.description: Creates a new conversation session and returns its unique ID, which must be used with all subsequent conversation requests to maintain context.

parameters.name: ucssa-userid
parameters.description: The user ID of the requesting user

parameters.name: ucssa-username
parameters.description: The username of the requesting user

parameters.name: ucssa-bps
parameters.description: JSON array of business partner IDs, e.g. ["1113855"]

tools.name: GET_getSessionLanguage
tools.title: GET_getSessionLanguage
tools.description: Retrieves the language setting for the specified chat session.

parameters.name: ucssa-userid
parameters.description: The user ID of the requesting user

parameters.name: ucssa-username
parameters.description: The username of the requesting user

parameters.name: ucssa-bps
parameters.description: JSON array of business partner IDs, e.g. ["1113855"]

parameters.name: sessionId
parameters.description:
Unique ID to identify the chat session.  
String value needs to be enclosed in single quotes
